posts.title: Swift Death of Statelessness
posts.description: My drive home from work is always spent in total silence. The monotony of Route 101 (it's not a flex) has an uncanny way of clearing cognitive noise. Today, somewhere in that quiet stretch of highway, reflecting on my work in the Kubernetes ecosystem, it struck me just how completely our industry is reinventing itself. For 15 years, cloud computing was worshiping a statelessness as an absolute dei
